failure_summary.description: Search results were returned without being assigned and saved to cache.
The agent repeated work on previously cached domains and omitted the newly requested restaurant search.
The agent substituted a similar attraction category instead of preserving the user's category wording.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly requires assigning and saving every tool result, so repeating that instruction would not patch a gap. The edits clarify how to prioritize a new request within an ongoing trip and preserve user-provided category values verbatim.

edits.content: - Identify the action requested in the latest user turn before acting on cached domains. When it introduces a new domain, perform that request rather than repeating unrelated earlier work; use the current trip destination as the location for an in-trip search when the context makes it unambiguous. If a required location remains unclear, ask for it rather than guessing.

edits.target: ## Validate tool arguments and preserve user intent
edits.content: - Pass user-provided entity and category values verbatim. Do not replace them with synonyms or nearby category labels unless the tool schema explicitly requires a mapping.
